newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile forex rules to help unite markets - Aninat.
newsitem.headline: Chile forex rules to help unite markets - Aninat.

text.p: A battery of Central Bank measures on foreign exchange rules will contribute toward unifying Chile's formal and informal currency markets, Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said.
Aninat praised the measures aimed at streamlining rules governing access to foreign currency for Chileans who want to invest abroad.

"In my opinion, it's important to simplify and make much more flexible the so-called Chapter 12, Title One, which is the vehicle for carrying out investments, deposits and credits by companies in Chile going overseas," said Aninat at Congress in Valparaiso.
"This measure benefits basically private parties. It's another step toward integrating the informal exchange market with the formal market," he told reporters.
He said it was too early to say what effect the measures would have on exchange rates, noting "an enormous number of variables affect the price (of the dollar)."
